description: Curated seed corpus of classic papers/concepts. Used when network is limited. Provenance: seed.

entries.title: Gödel Machines: Fully Self-Referential Optimal Universal Self-Improvers
entries.claim: A Gödel machine is a self-referential universal problem solver that can rewrite its own code when it finds a proof that the rewrite is useful.

entries.title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
entries.claim: The Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) empirically evolves coding agents by modifying their own code and evaluating improvements on coding benchmarks, without requiring formal proofs.

entries.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
entries.claim: Constitutional AI trains models to be harmless using a list of principles (a constitution) and AI feedback, reducing reliance on human labels for harmlessness.

entries.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
entries.claim: Reflexion agents improve via linguistic self-reflection stored in episodic memory, without weight updates.

entries.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
entries.claim: Voyager uses an LLM-driven automatic curriculum, a skill library, and iterative prompting to explore Minecraft open-endedly.

entries.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
entries.claim: Self-Refine improves LLM outputs by generating feedback on its own outputs and refining iteratively, without additional training.

entries.title: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation of Deep Networks (MAML)
entries.claim: MAML learns an initialization that can be quickly adapted to new tasks with few gradient steps.

entries.title: Auto-GPT: An Autonomous GPT-4 Experiment
entries.claim: Auto-GPT popularized autonomous LLM agent loops that decompose goals into tasks, use tools, and iterate without continuous human prompting.

entries.title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
entries.claim: OpenDevin (now OpenHands) is an open platform for software engineering agents that interact with code, terminals, and browsers.

entries.title: AI Safety via Debate
entries.claim: Debate proposes training agents to debate topics so that a human (or weaker judge) can identify truth more reliably than unaided evaluation.

entries.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
entries.claim: Generative agents simulate believable human behavior in an interactive sandbox using memory, reflection, and planning.

entries.title: Intelligence Explosion Microeconomics / Seed AI (conceptual lineage)
entries.claim: Recursive self-improvement refers to systems that improve their own intelligence and thereby accelerate further improvement; largely theoretical with limited empirical instances in narrow domains.
